sloka: निमित्तानि निमित्तज्ञो दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः ।सौमित्रिम् सम्परिष्वज्य इदम् वचनम्ब्रवीत् ॥६-२३-१॥।।
transliteration: nimittāni nimittajño dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ ।saumitrim sampariṣvajya idam vacanambravīt ॥6-23-1॥।।

translations.english: Perceiving the portents, Rama spoke these words embracing Saumithri who was aware of the portents.
